[EN] The sphere is emitting strange flashes of light.
[ES] La esfera emite extraños destellos de luz.

[EN] (You hear an unfamiliar male voice, accompanied by a low buzzing.)

"Isn't it ironic?
Those of you who opposed the Core are now trapped by its power...

How could any true elf resist such magic?

I have been watching you...for a long, long time.
My faith has been rewarded...that armor, those swords suit you well."
(The buzzing continues for a while, then stops.)Touch the sphere.Slowly take your hand away.
[ES] (Escuchas una voz masculina desconocida, acompañada de un zumbido bajo.)

"¿No es irónico?
Aquellos de ustedes que se opusieron al Core ahora están atrapados por su poder...

¿Cómo podría un verdadero elf resistirse a tal magia?

Los he estado observando... durante mucho, mucho tiempo.
Mi fe ha sido recompensada... esa armadura, esas espadas les quedan bien."
(El zumbido continúa un rato y luego se detiene.)Touch the sphere.Slowly take your hand away.
